title: Validate Binary Search Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree represented as an array, determine if it is a valid binary search tree (BST). A valid BST requires all left subtree nodes to be strictly less than the root, and all right subtree nodes to be strictly greater than the root. The array is in heap order: the children of the node at index `i` are at indexes `2i + 1` and `2i + 2`, and `null` means no node there.

hints.content: Every node must satisfy a valid range: min < val < max.
Passing left: max bound becomes node.val. Passing right: min bound becomes node.val.
function validate(idx, min, max) { if (tree[idx] <= min || tree[idx] >= max) return false; ... }.

solution.explanation:
DFS passing valid range bounds down to children. Left child bounded by (min, val), right child bounded by (val, max).
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(h)
